results.name: a real candidate with career, education, skills and a PDF CV is found in the database
the profile screen shows the name, the career and the education
the CV file opens from the production bucket through the app (read-only link)
the text read from the CV is available on the profile
the top-bar search finds a person by name across the whole database
the AI search returns candidates for a plain-language query
the keyword search (the fallback) returns candidates
the Database results screen lists people for that search
a saved search is stored and listed on the Database screen
the profile lists openings the person may fit, with a score
reverse matching adds database candidates to the opening as matches (at most 30)
the run is recorded with its counts
the matches are on the opening's Database CVs screen
a match somebody removed is not added again by the next run
the prepared CV is built from the extracted CV: career and education, with the Career141 block, no stand-in page
